what_this_is: A stable regression corpus for the correction policy. These cases cannot be scored by the test suite because the model makes the decision. Score them by running a session with the plugin installed and checking each case, then tune policy text only from observed failures.

how_to_read_a_case.id: an immutable case identifier used to prevent accidental corpus loss.
how_to_read_a_case.side: user means it arrives as a prompt. assistant means the answer concedes it, which the policy also has to catch.
how_to_read_a_case.expected: suggest, quiet, or either. either means the reading is genuinely ambiguous and both answers are defensible, so it must not be counted as a failure in either direction.
